title: Structure-Activity Relationships of Cu-ZrO2 Catalysts for CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol: Interaction Effects and Reaction Mechanism
extraction_notes: The SI contains one catalyst-performance plot: SI Figure S4 (page 1), methanol STY vs time-on-stream for CZ-350, CZ-450, CZ-550 and CZ-650 at T = 220 °C, CO2:H2 = 1:3, P = 3.0 MPa, GHSV = 3600 h−1. The plot has many closely spaced data points and the numerical STY/time values are not printed in the text or a table; exact point-by-point extraction was therefore not possible without estimating from a dense figure. Characterisation figures S1–S3 were out of scope.
